note: The app CSS's cascade order, flattened and hashed, and the rules themselves so a stale baseline can still say what moved. Re-stamp with `npm run css:order -- --update` only when the order is meant to change, and read the diff: a move that changes which rule wins is a change to the page.

@layer components ▸ .tag[data-mine]{background:transparent;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 45%, var(--line));color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 70%, var(--fg))}

@layer components ▸ @keyframes ring-pulse{{50% { outline-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--status) 22%, transparent); }}}
@layer components ▸ .agent-hover[data-shown="true"]{opacity:1;transition:opacity 100ms ease, left 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), top 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)}

@layer components ▸ .agent-tagbtn{display:grid;width:var(--control-sm);height:var(--control-sm);flex:none;place-items:center;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius-thumb);background:transparent;color:var(--faint);cursor:pointer;opacity:0;transition:opacity 120ms ease, background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease}

@layer components ▸ .board-del{position:absolute;top:50%;right:6px;display:grid;width:20px;height:20px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius-chip);background:none;color:var(--faint);cursor:pointer;opacity:0;place-items:center;translate:0 -50%;transition:opacity 120ms ease, background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease}

@layer components ▸ .action-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:24px;padding:0 9px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--control-radius, 8px);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;font:inherit;font-size:var(--type-label);transition:background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease}

@layer components ▸ @keyframes oc-fill{{0% { transform: translateY(100%); } 38%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }}}

@layer components ▸ .dock{position:absolute;z-index:var(--z-chrome);bottom:calc(12px + var(--keyboard) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));left:calc(var(--inset-left, 0px) + (100% - var(--inset-left, 0px) - var(--inset-right, 0px)) / 2);transition:left 160ms ease;display:flex;width:min(720px, max(320px, calc(100% - var(--inset-left, 0px) - var(--inset-right, 0px) - 64px)));flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:8px;transform:translateX(-50%);pointer-events:none}

@layer components ▸ .focus-exit{position:absolute;top:18px;left:calc((var(--band-left, var(--inset-left, 0px)) + var(--band-right, calc(100% - var(--inset-right, 0px)))) / 2);transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:var(--z-over-board);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:28px;padding:0 8px 0 8px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:var(--control-radius, 8px);background:var(--raise, var(--panel));box-shadow:var(--shadow);color:var(--fg);font:inherit;font-size:var(--type-ui);font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 120ms ease, background-color 120ms ease}

@layer components ▸ .board-node > .news-glow::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:var(--radius-panel, 12px);box-shadow:0 0 60px 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--news, var(--color-accent)) 40%, transparent), 0 4px 18px rgb(0 0 0 / 19%);will-change:opacity;animation:news-breathe 2.6s ease-in-out infinite}

@layer components ▸ @keyframes act-settle{{from { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--act) 26%, transparent); } to { background: transparent; }}}

@layer components ▸ .agent-cursor{position:absolute;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;transform:scale(calc(1 / var(--zoom, 1)));transform-origin:0 0;pointer-events:none;transition:left 380ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), top 380ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), opacity 600ms ease-out}
@layer components ▸ @keyframes cursor-bob{{0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-2.5px); }}}
@layer components ▸ @keyframes cursor-breathe{{0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.16; } 50% { transform: scale(1.22); opacity: 0.08; }}}
@layer components ▸ @keyframes cursor-ping{{from { width: 8px; height: 8px; margin: -4px 0 0 -4px; opacity: 0.85; } to { width: 64px; height: 64px; margin: -32px 0 0 -32px; opacity: 0; }}}

@theme{--color-grey-50:#ffffff;--color-grey-100:#fafafa;--color-grey-200:#f2f2f2;--color-grey-300:#eeeeee;--color-grey-400:#dbdbdb;--color-grey-500:#aeaeae;--color-grey-600:#808080;--color-grey-700:#5c5c5c;--color-grey-800:#3a3a3a;--color-grey-900:#2e2e2e;--color-grey-1000:#242424;--color-grey-1100:#161616;--color-grey-1200:#080808;--color-accent:#3b5cf6;--color-accent-soft:#d7e2fc;--color-warn:#e7af36;--color-danger:#d92e3c;--color-ok:#2eaf5a;--font-sans:"Inter", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;--font-mono:"JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace}

:root{--keyboard:0px;--row-radius:14px;--radius-pill:999px;--radius-inline:4px;--radius-thumb:5px;--radius-chip:6px;--radius-item:7px;--radius-doc:10px;--control:28px;--control-md:26px;--control-sm:22px;--field:24px;--control-radius:8px;--bg:var(--color-grey-100);--bg-deep:var(--color-grey-200);--panel:var(--color-grey-50);--fg:var(--color-grey-1100);--muted:var(--color-grey-700);--faint:var(--color-grey-600);--line:rgb(0 0 0 / 10%);--line-strong:rgb(0 0 0 / 20%);--border-strong:var(--line-strong);--fill:var(--color-grey-400);--shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 6%), 0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 5%);--shadow-row:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 8%), 0 3px 10px rgb(0 0 0 / 7%);--shadow-menu:0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 6%), 0 4px 10px rgb(0 0 0 / 10%), 0 16px 36px rgb(0 0 0 / 12%);--stage:var(--color-grey-100);--type-tag:9.5px;--type-micro:10px;--type-hint:10.5px;--type-note:11px;--type-label:11.5px;--type-ui:12px;--type-copy:12.5px;--type-body:13px;--type-name:14px;--type-title:15px;--z-board-edit:2;--z-over-board:5;--z-mark:6;--z-conversation:9;--z-chrome:10;--z-turnbar:11;--z-backdrop:20;--z-float:30;--z-menu:40;--z-popup:60;--z-present:200;color-scheme:light}

[data-color-scheme="dark"]{--bg:var(--color-grey-1100);--bg-deep:var(--color-grey-1200);--panel:var(--color-grey-1000);--fg:var(--color-grey-100);--muted:var(--color-grey-500);--faint:var(--color-grey-600);--line:rgb(255 255 255 / 12%);--line-strong:rgb(255 255 255 / 24%);--border-strong:#ffffff1f;--fill:var(--color-grey-800);--shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 40%), 0 6px 18px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%);--shadow-row:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 45%), 0 3px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 38%);--shadow-menu:0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 50%), 0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 55%), 0 18px 44px rgb(0 0 0 / 50%);--stage:#101010;color-scheme:dark}
